name: Zelefin
description: Companion for the Zelefin iOS app. Notifications, home-row hiding, and library lookups.
overview: Companion plugin for the Zelefin iOS app

versions.changelog: Hide titles from Home without clearing watch history. TMDB ownership and collection lookups so the app does not scan the whole library.
Initial release: Seerr defaults, Intro Skipper lock, and iPhone notifications through Zelefin’s push service.
